In the City of Pittsburgh, County of Allegheny, Commonwealth of Pennsylvania,

by and between
UNIVERSITY OF PITTSBURGH -
OF THE COMMONWEALTH SYSTEM OF HIGHER EDUCATION
("University")

and

MICHAEL A. HAYWOOD
("Employee")

In consideration of the promises hereinafter contained and other good and valuable

consideration, and intending to be legally bound hereby, the parties agree as follows:

1.0 Employment

1.1 Subject to the terms and conditions stated in this Employment Contract
(“Contract”), the University hereby employs Michael A. Haywood as Head
Football Coach of the University’s varsity intercollegiate football team
(“Team”), and Michael A, Haywood hereby accepts said employment. The
University and the Employee acknowledge the Employee has completed a
University Employment Application form (“Application”). The Employee
hereby warrants that he has filled out the Application, which is incorporated

herein by reference, ina complete, accurate and truthful manner.

 2.0

3.0



Term

The term of this Contract shall be effective on December 16, 2010, and shall
expire January 15, 2016, unless otherwise extended or terminated as
provided herein (“Term”). A “Contract Year” shall be the annual period of
January 16 through the next ensuing January 15, during the Term; except that
the first Contract Year shall begin on the effective date of this Contract and
shall extend through January 15, 2012.

Ata mutually convenient time between January 15,2013 and March 31,2013,
the Employee and the University’s Director of Athletics shall meet to discuss
the Team, this Contract, the Employee’s performance hereunder and the
desirability of a possible extension of the Term of this Contract. Atthat time,

the University — in its sole discretion — may consider an extension of the Term

hereof.

Compensation and Fringe Benefits

During the period in which the Employee serves as the University’s Head Football
Coach:

3.]

The Employee shall receive, as compensation for his services to the
University and satisfactory performance of the terms and conditions of this

Contract, a base Salary at the per annum rate of One Million Dollars
($1,000,000).

All such annual base salary shall be paid to the Employee in equal monthly

installments, on the last day of each calendar month.


3.2

3.3

3.4

Employee shall receive the standard staff fringe benefits received by the
University's staff, as described in the University of Pittsburgh's Staff
Handbook. If any such benefit is based in whole or in part upon salary paid to
the Employee, such consideration shall be made without including any
income other than the applicable base salary amount as described in

provision 3.1 hereof,

The University shall pay initiation fees and monthly membership dues for
the Employee at a mutually agreed upon golf or country club, which
membership shall be used by the Employee for development and
entertainment activities associated with the Employee's official

responsibilities.

The University shall make available to the Employee, ona loan basis, one (1)

dealer-provided automobile from the car dealer program of the University’s
Department of Athletics (“Department”), for the Employee’s official and
personal use, fully insured by the University; provided that:

(1) The University’s obligation to provide such an automobile shall cease
if the dealer car program of the Department is terminated for any
reason or if the Employee fails or refuses to comply fully with the

University’s requirements for participation in the program.

(2) The University’s obligation to provide such an automobile shall cease
if the Employee fails, at any time, properly to care for said
automobile in accordance with the manufacturer’s and the dealer’s

specifications and to maintain the said automobile in the same

Employee shall return the automobile to the University, immediately upon

any other automobile from, or through, the University.

tickets for any away game in which the Team participates, all of which shall
be used for his official responsibilities.

of-pocket expenses reasonably incurred by him for the purpose of and in
connection with the performance of his duties under this Contract, including
but not limited to NCAA approved expenses incurred while recruiting and
scouting. All such reimbursement shall be made in accordance with the
standard procedures of the University upon presentation to the University of

vouchers or other statements itemizing such expenses in reasonable detail.


3.7

under this Contract, he shall be entitled to receive supplemental

compensation in consideration for his efforts in contributing to the

exceptional performance of the Team and for the extra services required of

the Employee in preparation for and participation in post-season games of

the Team. Specifically, the Employee shall be entitled to the following:

A.

The greatest of:

(2)

(3)

One Hundred Fifty Thousand ($ 150,000) for a Contract Year in
which the Team wins the post-season national championship
game, played as a part of the national Bow] Championship

Series, or similar successor series; or

season football champion of the Big East Conference (or such other

Thousand Dollars ($150,000) per year, during each Contract Year. The
applicable amounts shall be payable to the Employee, in each Contract Year,

September and the first day of January (by January 1, 2012 for the first
Contract Year).

at Heinz Field, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

also select such assistants and applicable staff, as authorized by the
University, who shall be committed, likewise, to devoting their full time,
attention and energies to the furtherance of the athletics program of the
University. The Employee shall comply fully with the legislation, rules,
regulations and policies of the National Collegiate Athletic Association
(“NCAA”), of the Big East Conference (or such other applicable athletics
conference in which the University is then a member, affiliated with and/or
competes) of the University and of the Department (including without
limitation the mission statements of the University and of the Department
and the principles of “The Pitt Promise”), and he shall take every precaution
to ensure that all members of his staff comply fully with such legislation,

rules, regulations and policies.

Coach:

Contract, shall be the Director of Athletics of the University, and all matters
pertaining to the operation of the University’s athletics program including,
but not limited to, those set forth in provisions 5.2 and 5.3 below, shall be

subject to the direction and control of the said Director of Athletics.

account this Contract, prior performance evaluations of the Employee and

University’s Director of Athletics.

give proper time and attention to, and shall perform in good faith and to the
